title: Amount of Grant and Subsidies Given to PAP Community Foundation for Set-up and Operation of Childcare Centres and Kindergartens
what_it_is: Amount of Grant and Subsidies Given to PAP Community Foundation for Set-up and Operation of Childcare Centres and Kindergartens

sections.label: Government preschool funding schemes
sections.summary: The Government funds preschool operators through Anchor and Partner Operator schemes and MOE Kindergartens, with grants given to AOPs in return for fee caps and quality demands.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To achieve this, the Government funds operators through the Anchor Operator and Partner Operator (AOP) schemes and runs Ministry of Education (MOE) Kindergartens.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There are currently five AOPs, including People's Action Party (PAP) Community Foundation (PCF) Sparkletots preschool.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Government grants are provided to AOPs in return for them adhering to fee caps for the preschool places they provide, plus significant demands on efforts to improve quality and invest in teacher development.

sections.label: PCF grants and political activities
sections.summary: From 2014 to 2018, average grants per SC child were about $3,500 yearly at PCF Sparkletots versus $4,300 across all AOPs, and the Member asked about subsidised facilities for political activities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: From 2014 to 2018, the average amount of grants provided for each SC child enrolled in PCF Sparkletots translated to about $3,500 per year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For comparison, the corresponding average figure across all AOPs during the same period was about $4,300.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Does the Ministry have the actual amount that was given to PCF kindergarten, the subsidy that was given to them for the last five years, as listed in the question?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: My second question is: what is the Government's view on allowing these state-subsidised facility to be used for political activities like Meet-the-People sessions (MPS) and all that?

sections.label: Refer to previous answers
sections.summary: The Minister urged the Member to refer to previous answers in the House on his question.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For the Member's second question, Sir, I think a lot have been discussed in this House on the question that he has asked, so I would like to urge him to refer to those answers.
